groups.title: Main Street
groups.note: The Wax Cylinder, Ackerman's Toys, Pope's Maritime Insurance and Johnston's Genealogy are all stores on Blackwood Main Street

groups.title: The Athena
groups.note: The ill-fated train involved in the Blackwood Railway Disaster.

groups.title: Fairfields
groups.note: A legendary bootlegging family, notorious for their strong liquor and murderous tendencies.

groups.title: Cypress Creek
groups.note: All four of the people were transformed by the waters in Cypress Creek.

groups.note: All are bodies of water found in Blackwood Forest

groups.title: The Bloody Picnic
groups.note: The four Girl Scouts involved in Bloody Picnic were Jane Blackwood, Ella Chapdelaine, Sylvia Pascal and Ginger Simcock.

groups.title: Mayors
groups.note: Henry Blackwood, Arthur Fairfield, Lester Jackson and Phillip Blackwood were all mayors of Blackwood

groups.title: Authors
groups.note: Edgar Charles, Mary Whitaker, Constance Whitfield and Sam Mae are all published book authors.

groups.title: The Lee Family
groups.note: Edith, David, Eliza and Constance are all members of the Lee Family

groups.title: Disappeared
groups.note: Ralph Ingall, Daryl Hennessy, Constance Whitfield and Ranger Thurman all disappeared in Blackwood Forest

groups.title: Died Young
groups.note: Bernard, Louis and Lissa Blackwood, along with Bruce Fairfield died before the age of 20.
